context.narrative_job: Define the deliverable and the payment trigger so they stay on the right side of the regulated line.
context.viewer_before: S17: you are the surveyor; a cut of the sale is regulated.
context.viewer_after: The promise is a signed checklist; the fixed fee is paid on acceptance, and tying it to the deal crosses the line.

data.choice: Unpaid animation: the sale marker with three dashed unknowns and an owner who does not control them; the S16 scope returns as a checklist with illustrative statuses (resolved, deferred with a reason, out of scope on 'Value the business') and her signature; heading 'The acceptance event'; the S17 red boundary with the fixed fee paid on acceptance on the safe side and a dashed oxide line to the sale crossing it, labelled Regulated.
data.reason: Keeps acceptance attached to the work, not the sale, and reuses the boundary so the regulatory logic reads as continuous from S17.

reuse.avoid_when: The provider is paid on the outcome.

data.insight: A stroke draw-on sets stroke-dasharray to the path length, erasing any dash pattern; a dashed line must have its pattern set back after the draw completes, and the result checked in a still.
